verbatim_clauses.text: Direct day-to-day high-volume dining, floor execution, front-of-house service standards, and labor shift balancing.
Drive prime cost management, inventory reconciliation, food/beverage cost variance controls, and margin optimization.
Recruit, onboard, train, and develop hospitality workforce across FOH/BOH, enforcing accountability and retention.
Maintain strict audit readiness, health department compliance, food safety certifications, and liquor licensing (MLCC).
Lead hospitality service culture, resolve high-stakes guest escalations, and coordinate multi-outlet/banquet crossover.

negative_space_constraints: No outside sales / pure commission quotas
On-premise high-volume dining room focus, not remote customer support
